messages:
katie: quick async standup — what I did: prewarmed ams1 pool for tilt canary, ran a small smokebench against c2 instances, validated autoscaler policy change landed. blockers: seeing a weird 10–15% higher token p95 for long prompts in ams1, not sure if it's node type or kernel. today: will run a focused perf run and open a rollback if it looks like kernel regression. ping @matt for quota snapshot.

matt: thanks — grabbed quota snapshot, ams1 has 8 spare GPUs in reserved pool and ~18 in burst spot today. linking snapshot: https://internal/quotas/ams1/2026-03-17

jess: i bumped the dedicated pool to 12 -> 16 for the canary window. watching costs but wanted headroom. ran:
```
rgctl pool update --name=ams1-dedicated --size=16
```
reaction :thumbsup:

devon: saw the autoscale change — can you share the exact policy? i want to confirm cool-down and target utilization. last time short cool-down caused oscillation.

katie: policy is in PR #2384 — target 0.65, cooldown 120s. i left max surge at +25%.

sre-jen: small note — we've had two spot evictions in ams1 in last 6h, both during the early morning window. if we rely on spot for burst we should prewarm a few on dedicated to avoid tail latency hits.

matt: good call. i can reserve 4 more dedicated for the next 24h and flip back after the canary. cost estimate ~ +0.6k/day. approve? @finance?

jess: approved from infra side. i'll add a cheap alert to the latency dashboard to fire at 95th token latency > 800ms for long prompts.

ops-bot: [deploy-bot] canary deployment started for model:redwood-2-small in ams1 at 2026-03-17T09:12:40Z

katie: updating thread — perf run shows p95 up 12% only for sequences > 2k tokens. short sequences unaffected. i'm leaning towards a kernel selection mismatch for long-seq path. i'll diff kernel logs and share.

devon: if it's kernel, lets revert to previous kernels for ams1 first, then test. i can own the rollback if you give the go.

katie: go for rollback if p95 stays elevated after next 30m. i'll post logs and the canary signal.

sre-jen: opened INC-4129 to track this and added runbook link: https://internal/incidents/INC-4129

matt: noted. i'll create a temporary quota ticket to keep the extra 4 dedicated GPUs until we confirm stability.

jess: heads up — i added a small prefix cache flush to the canary job to rule out stale kv cache artifacts. command used:
```
redis-cli -h cache-ams1 FLUSHDB
```

katie: thanks. i'll re-run the long-seq bench in 10m and update. :eyes:

ops-bot: [deploy-bot] canary deployment completed: 12/12 warm instances healthy, ramping traffic to 10% at 2026-03-17T09:26:05Z

devon: rolled back kernels on two nodes manually and they passed a quick perf check. need coordinated window to roll back fleet-wide if this is the fix.

katie: noted — let's hold on fleet-wide until we have full bench. if rollback is the fix we schedule tonight's maintenance window.

matt: thanks all. if anyone needs me to action the quota ticket or cost approval, ping — i can fast-track.

jess: copy. will keep dashboard watch and post any alerts here.

katie: end update — i'll post final result in ~30m.
